items: Merge branch 'master' of https://github.com/sigma67/ytmusicapi into sigma67-master

initial commit of new download functionality and supporting fixes. no cli yet... but the bulk of the new features are implemented as a mixin in mixins/downloads.py. There are some supporting functions added to parsers/utils.py for searching in nested dict trees based on key-sequence-paths etc, and some fixes in mixins/browsing.py and parsers/browsing.py that use them to handle changes to youtube's page layout and internal api structures that ytmusicapi works with, (hopefully) in a way that will be somewhat resistant to future changes made by youtube.
